rows.grounds: feminine form indicating a golden item or quantity
locative tatpuruṣa compound expressing absence of that prior item
names the substitute substance Terminalia bellirica

items.question: What substitute material is prescribed when the golden item is unavailable?
premises: A golden item is indicated as an option.
That golden item may be absent.
Beleric myrobalan is named for that condition.
items.inference: Beleric myrobalan serves as the substitute when the golden item is unavailable.
uncertainties: The exact referent of haimavatī is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: A golden one; in its absence, beleric myrobalan.
